_why: Round 5 of the Appearance panel, from Destin's review-4 answers: AR4-1 smaller gap under the last theme, AR4-3 the opened Look settings inside the Customize look box, AR4-4 Message box removed and tied to the layout. Whole-panel pictures have the popup's height cap lifted in the screenshot only.
title: Appearance panel — round 5: tighter themes box, one Customize look box

steps.path: Settings → Appearance → Themes, scrolled to the end
steps.headline: The last theme now sits 8 px above the buttons instead of 16 px.
steps.changed: At the end of the list, the gap between the last card and Browse / Build matches the gap between cards.
steps.notice: The box also got 8 px shorter at the end of the list, and the cards still slide under the buttons while you scroll.

steps.headline: Customize look opens as one box, and Message box is gone.
steps.changed: The row's tinted box now continues down and holds Message bubbles, Roundness and Glass. Message box was removed. Picking a layout now brings its matching message box: Framed and Minimalist use the standard bar, and Floating bars uses the floating one. Auto layout leaves each theme's own message box alone.
steps.notice: Inside the box, the Glass strip and the Fine-tune row keep a slightly darker tint of their own. If that reads as a box inside a box, say so in a note and I'll flatten them.
